scope: Read-only review of app.js preparation integration plus executable actor-state regressions; no app mutation by this review.

reviewedPaths.localIntro: setVisual(local_intro) starts preparation only when barefootPrepared is false and no action is active.
reviewedPaths.blocking: choose() refuses while footwearRemoval.active; native Next is disabled each frame until completion.
reviewedPaths.replay: Replay retains activeNode and previous view; completion restores visual zone using activeNode and then previous view.
reviewedPaths.saveRestore: Completion records barefootPrepared=true. Reload during mandatory local_intro preparation restarts from shoes, rather than silently marking partial animation completed. Replay is a view-only action and reloading returns to the saved learning node.
reviewedPaths.staticReset: Root change setGaitPhase(null) immediately restores static foot targets when leaving manual gait, avoiding residual swing-foot state.

correctedActorIssue: Removed garments previously inherited patient root travel. Completion now reparents them to a scene-owned stationary group with world transforms retained, and explicit rewear resets their bone parenting.

executableEvidence.gaitRegression: 101 samples, max ankle target error 1.1590684261107436e-7 m; finite values, minimum sole Y 0.0009999206285785222 m.
executableEvidence.appearanceRegression: Independent male/female display refinement, 163 bones each, no invalid attribute numbers; original lower-leg surface unchanged.

visualAndClinicalReview: Teacher/browser review remains separate; fine cloth and fingertip contact are not validated.
